authorizing_request: Close stage3 development and initiate stage3.5 research into the physical/numerical confidence domain before final stages4–5.
purpose: Establish physically justified ranges, joint constraints, margins and interpretation limits for every relevant variable family; not a simulation sweep testing whether all combinations pass.
confidence_domain_meaning: A supported domain of physical validity and numerical use, not an assigned statistical confidence interval.
primary_experiment: Korzh et al., 2020, Demonstration of sub-3 ps temporal resolution with a superconducting nanowire single-photon detector
complementary_reference: Allmaras, 2020 doctoral thesis; each model and temperature belongs to its own stated scenario.

geometry_policy.primary_representation: 2D strip; thickness is a material/geometric parameter rather than a resolved third dimension.
geometry_policy.one_dimensional_reduction: Optional and conditional on future full-transient evidence of negligible transverse variation for all relevant fields and populations over the observation window.
geometry_policy.tradeoff: Resolve formation and evolution of the hotbelt, avoid materially early/strong influence from terminal boundaries, and control computational cost.
required_distinctions: distance from absorption and excited region to external boundaries
geometry_policy.boundary_margin: Choose through physical transport/escape scales and an observable-specific influence budget. Diffusion has nonzero tails immediately; absence of a sharp arrival does not mean absence of contamination.
geometry_policy.no_boundary_fix_by_deletion: Do not remove energy, clip populations or inject an artificial diffusive sink to force a shorter domain to pass.

research_outputs: A selected, identifiable reference sample and measurement configuration
A range ledger with units, provenance, uncertainty, hypothesis status and coupled constraints
A distinction between measured values, published model fits, inherited scenarios and numerical choices
Candidate domain lengths, reduction criteria and observation-window/boundary margins
Observable definitions and numerical budgets justified by physical scales and experimental comparison
Explicit unknowns, extrapolation triggers and the future evidence needed to resolve them

observable_policy.latency_vs_jitter: Do not equate deterministic latency or time-step size with the width of an experimental timing distribution.
observable_policy.measurement_chain: Declare optical reference, propagation, electrical response, threshold, noise and deconvolution assumptions for each comparison.
observable_policy.statistical_model: A deterministic trajectory does not by itself predict a jitter FWHM. Additional physical distributions must be justified and registered if a statistical prediction is attempted.
observable_policy.numerical_budget: Do not inherit an excessively strict universal tolerance. Allocate accuracy to the observable and use relative criteria only away from zero.

carryover_requirements_before_stage4_5: Weak coupled spatial trajectory and its time/space/spectral evidence
Current-dependent reservoir branch and consistent dynamic work
Kinetic equal-energy interface transport and shared phonon ownership
Complete external boundary conditions and dynamic influence of domain length
Physical justification of any1D reduction and continued spatial admissibility D.36
completed_in_this_delivery: Initial source research, code-parameter inventory and plan. No final range or device-specific confidence domain is admitted.
exit_condition: Reviewed range/constraint ledger with explicit unresolved limits and decision on what stages4–5 can physically claim; all necessary carried-over implementation gates remain binding.
